extraction.notes: No current official summer camp offering in Weaverville or elsewhere within the Asheville-area drive range was found. The supplied summer directory lists North Carolina sites only in Belville, Broadway and Charlotte, all outside the area. Searches found a third-party Asheville-Weaverville summer listing and an undated official testimonial mentioning a Weaverville clinic, but neither establishes a 2026 or 2027 local summer offering. No local card was created. The homepage's 2027 registration announcement is for Spring Training, not summer. Summer 2027 dates and registration milestones were not found.
